Set by tools such as `slint-viewer`, the LSP (editor diagnostics/preview), and the
live-reload runtime to indicate that the `.slint` file is being previewed rather than
driven by real host application logic.

9588.name: new
9588.docs: Create a new node from a SyntaxNode, if the SyntaxNode is of the correct kind

2867.name: field_order
2867.docs:
The field names in declaration order. The C++ generator emits struct
members in this order (positional aggregate initialization relies on
it), which `fields` — a sorted map — does not preserve.

7372.name: visit_repeater_model_expression
7372.docs:
Visit the model expression of `elem`, if `elem` is the body of a `for`.

The expression is temporarily moved out of `repeated.model` so the visitor
can mutate it without holding a borrow on `elem`.

4175.name: cells_variable
4175.docs: The local variable (as read with [`Self::ReadLocalVariable`]) that contains the cells

651.name: is_slint_sc
651.docs:
Whether the compilation targets the Slint SC subset. Callable without
the `slint-sc` feature, unlike reading the field, so call sites need
no `cfg` of their own.

10315.name: warning
10315.docs: Reports a warning at the current token location

3921.name: sub_component_use_sites
3921.docs:
Source location of each child sub-component's use-site element,
one entry per [`SubComponent::sub_components`](super::SubComponent::sub_components).
Distinguishes the instantiations of a shared sub-component type.

4248.name: repeater_index
4248.docs: Index of the repeater within the ctx.current_sub_component

5556.name: element_infos
5556.docs: Maps item index to a list of encoded element infos of the element  (type name, qualified ids).

2359.name: UnitProduct
2359.docs:
A type made up of the product of several "unit" types.
The first parameter is the unit, and the second parameter is the power.
The vector should be sorted by 1) the power, 2) the unit.

10788.name: is_url

The optional names of the arguments (empty string means not set).
The names are not technically part of the type, but it is good to have them available for auto-completion

4140.name: LayoutCacheAccess

Standard cache access (box layouts and static grid cells).

5448.name: index_in_tree

3886.name: qualified_id

4867.name: GridLayoutChildLayoutInfo
4867.docs:
Layout info (constraints) for a direct child of a repeated Row in a GridLayout.
Used to generate `layout_item_info` which returns layout info for a specific child.

1670.name: ReadLocalVariable
1670.docs:
a reference to the local variable with the given name. The type system should ensure that a variable has been stored
with this name and this type before in one of the statement of an enclosing codeblock

2324.name: accessibility_action_argument_count
2324.docs:
The number of arguments taken by the accessibility action of the given name, where the name
is the `AccessibilityAction` variant in pascal case (such as `SetSelectionOffsets`).

The `AccessibilityAction` enum of the run-time library mirrors the `accessible-action-*`
callbacks declared in the type register: a variant has one field per callback argument, so
that the generators can bind the fields without knowing about any particular action.

6175.name: with_expected_type
6175.docs: Run `f` with `expected_type` temporarily set to `ty`, restoring it afterwards.

11007.name: all_files_to_watch
11007.docs:
Returns all file paths whose on-disk changes can affect the current document graph.

This includes loaded documents and unresolved import targets that are kept in the
dependency graph so newly created files can invalidate their dependents.

2143.name: pretty_print
